art.birth_date: date given as %Y/%-m/%-d (for instance, 1839/1/9), or omit if not relevant
art.composition: visual arrangement indicating a centered asymmetric focus, symmetric balance, dynamic diagonal layout, crowded layers, or sparse large empty spaces.
art.nationality: nationality of the artist (e.g., french, japanese)
art.century: period during which the artist was active or influential (e.g., 19th or 19th–20th; may cover several centuries)
art.awards: Enter a whole number representing the total count of notable and well-documented accolades the artist has obtained (use 0 if there are none; do not include any awards like medals, scholarships, or token recognitions).
art.field: primary artistic field, select one or multiple options from: [Painting, Sculpture, Printmaking, Drawing, Photography, Illustration, Collage, Textile Art, Installation, Performance, Ceramics, Digital Art, Architecture, Mosaic, Graphic Design, Calligraphy], separated by `||` (e.g. Collage || Illustration || Textile Art).
art.death_city: The location of the artist's death, or leave blank if unknown
art.death_date: date given as %Y/%-m/%-d (e.g., 1836/1/1), or omit if not applicable
art.birth_city: place of birth for the artist (e.g., city)
